final_decision.reason: No signal re-interpretation or support-PSNR test supports any change. Subtype ambiguity resolved in favor of glass (gaussian:2 -3.3 dB, lens:3 -3.2 dB on two contents); severity 3 confirmed by +/-1 sweep (glass2 -2.51 dB pair0; glass4 -1.10 dB mean over 5/5 worse); JPEG sev1 and no-noise conclusion unchanged. Overall UNCERTAIN remains only for the inherent stochastic glass ceiling and unrepresentable hidden low-sigma noise.
